_README: MINIMAL real-A6 config for the viam:ethercat:a6-servo motor model. All a
conformant CiA402 drive needs: the required identity/motor facts + the A6's
#18: there is NO control_mode and NO rxpdo/txpdo. The driver is ALWAYS
switch-capable and defines ONE fixed CiA402 superset PDO map itself:
Each motor API call ensures its own mode at runtime: GoTo/GoFor -> PP,
SetRPM -> PV (the driver orchestrates the switch).
velocity gate off (noise-robust position-delta). Override either only if needed.

motor nameplate before ENERGIZING. require_realtime defaults true (needs
name: servo

attributes._comment_motor: Required motor facts. counts_per_rev = encoder counts per MOTOR rev at the drive's 1:1 electronic gear (A6 = 131072 = 2^17). motor_rated_current_amps = nameplate rated current (amps -> torque per-mille).
attributes._comment_a6_hw: A6-EC non-default hardware bits. The A6 supports ONLY DC sync (free-run -> AL 0x0027), on a 250 us SYNC0 granularity -- config data, set here. Its fault-reset (vendor SDO 0x2031:01=1), no-SYNC0 code (0x8700/Er74.1), and 0x603F gloss now live IN CODE in the viam:ethercat:a6-servo model (an A6ServoDriver subclass), NOT as config attributes (#15 item 2).
attributes._comment_optional: Everything else is OPTIONAL: position_tolerance_counts (default counts_per_rev/720), velocity_threshold (default: position-delta), gear_ratio (1.0), peak_current_amps, loop_rate_hz (1000), quick_stop_decel (0x6085) for a controlled ramp-stop. Add only what a bench measurement or the app requires.
